title: Securing Agentic Commerce Through Behavior-Aware Fraud Detection and Cybersecurity for Trusted AI-Agent Payment Authorization
abstract: arXiv:2610.27483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing use of autonomous artificial intelligence agents in digital commerce creates new security concerns involving agent impersonation, unauthorized payments, compromised agents, and misuse of delegated authority. This research introduces the Autonomous Commerce Agent Guard System (ACAGS), a cybersecurity framework combining supervised machine learning, behavioral analytics, agent-specific authorization controls, and explainable AI. The framework was evaluated using synthetic financial transaction data augmented with simulated agent characteristics and five adversarial scenarios. XGBoost was selected following comparisons with alternative classifiers. Across ten experimental runs, behavioral features improved mean F1-score from 52.12% to 67.49%, with agent-specific features increasing performance to 69.46%. The framework achieved detection rates of 99.77% for abnormal agent behavior, 99.73% for impersonation, and 100% for malicious

translated_title: 通过行为感知欺诈检测与网络安全技术保障智能体商务：实现可信AI智能体支付授权
translated_abstract: 自主人工智能智能体在数字商务中的日益普及带来了新的安全隐患，包括智能体身份冒用、未经授权的支付、智能体被攻陷以及委托权限的滥用。本研究提出了自主商务智能体防护系统，这是一个结合了监督机器学习、行为分析、智能体专用授权控制和可解释人工智能的网络安全框架。该框架使用合成金融交易数据进行评估，数据中加入了模拟智能体特征和五种对抗场景。经过与其他分类器的对比，最终选定了XGBoost。在十次实验运行中，行为特征将平均F1分数从52.12%提升至67.49%，而智能体专用特征进一步将性能提升至69.46%。该框架对异常智能体行为的检测率达到99.77%，对身份冒用的检测率达到99.73%，对恶意（支付）的检测率达到100%。
tldr: 该论文提出ACAGS网络安全框架，通过融合监督机器学习、行为分析、智能体专用授权控制和可解释AI，实现了对AI智能体支付欺诈的高精度检测（异常行为99.77%、身份冒用99.73%、恶意支付100%）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ACAGS, a cybersecurity framework integrating supervised machine learning, behavioral analytics, agent-specific authorization controls, and explainable AI to achieve high-accuracy detection of AI-agent payment fraud (99.77% for abnormal behavior, 99.73% for impersonation, and 100% for malicious payments).
